title: The Distant Gravity
author: Emrys Ashgrove
blurb: Isandro Galloway, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
